import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    # Fix island label variants (lowercase to proper case)
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to number (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2).to_dict()
    return result
